g.text: leaves it. Fine if both move in lock-step.

g.text: Following is what makes plain timed execution fragile: if AGV-1 is a little late, AGV-3 drives into W18 while AGV-1 is still there. The type-2 edges of an ADG exist exactly to order such

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: hand-overs (AGV-1 must finish leaving before AGV-3 starts entering).

g.text: Two AGVs on three waypoints of the Pecos north-south aisle, shown at two consecutive time steps. A valid MAPF plan contains no vertex and no swap conflicts; following is normally permitted.
